ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and money flow in the Feeding Our Future program to identify any potential wrongdoing or corruption.
questions: How did the program's funds get misused?
Who benefited from the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and corruption in the Feeding Our Future program. By following the money, we can identify any potential shell companies or suspicious transactions.
